body:
**Yogyakarta, September 17, 2026.** Laboratory management and strengthening of the research ecosystem were the focus of Universitas Muhammadiyah Sorong's (UNAMIN) visit to the Smart Agriculture Research Center, Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems, Faculty of Agricultural Technology (FTP) UGM, Thursday (17/9/2026). This visit was part of a collaborative activity between UGM's Faculty of Forestry and UNAMIN, and served as an opportunity to exchange knowledge regarding facility management and research development in higher education institutions.

The UNAMIN delegation consisted of Vice Rector IV for Planning, Cooperation, Resources and Business Units, Ir. Irman Amri, ST., MT., IPM., and Dean of the Faculty of Engineering, Dr. Ir. Hendrik Pristianto, S.T., M.T., IPM. The activity was also attended by Dean of UGM's Faculty of Forestry, Prof. Dr. Dwiko Budi Permadi, and Dr. Ratih Madya Septiana. From the Smart Agriculture Research Center, the visit was received by Research Coordinator, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, and his team.

In opening remarks, Dwiko conveyed that UNAMIN had obtained funding grants for an integrated laboratory. In relation to this, the visit was utilized to study laboratory management, research, and supporting facilities within UGM, at the university, faculty, and departmental levels.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1021-1-image-1.webp)

The discussion also covered research institutions at UGM. Dwiko introduced the existence of research centers at the university level, research centers within faculty environments, and research groups. This discussion provided an overview of various forms of research organizations that could be considered in the development of UNAMIN's integrated laboratory.

On the same occasion, Andri introduced the Smart Agriculture Research Center under the Department of Agricultural Engineering and Biosystems at FTP UGM. He explained the support from UGM AI and NVIDIA for research being developed as one of the flagship research initiatives. A number of research areas were introduced to the delegation, including open field agriculture, indoor farming, and irrigation modernization.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1021-2-image-2-773x1030.webp)

Beyond discussions, the delegation toured research facilities, including the design laboratory, agricultural mechanization, testing facilities for agricultural equipment and machinery, and the Smart Agri Plant Factory. This tour provided UNAMIN delegates an opportunity to directly observe facilities supporting research and agricultural technology development activities at FTP UGM.

The visit to the Smart Agri Plant Factory coincided with the harvest season. Through this tour, the delegation was able to observe indoor cultivation activities as part of the smart agriculture research being developed by the Smart Agriculture Research Center team.

In follow-up discussions, Irman expressed hope that communication could continue, including should UGM's team have activities scheduled in Manokwari or Oransbari. Such opportunities were hoped to be utilized to obtain feedback regarding the development of testing laboratory facilities in Sorong.

This visit served as a forum for exchanging experience in laboratory management and research development between higher education institutions. Through continuous communication, collaboration between UGM and UNAMIN is expected to support the strengthening of research facilities and higher education institution capacity in addressing regional development needs.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 17 September 2026.** Pengelolaan laboratorium dan penguatan ekosistem penelitian menjadi fokus kunjungan Universitas Muhammadiyah Sorong (UNAMIN) ke Smart Agriculture Research Center, Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian (FTP) UGM, Kamis (17/9/2026). Kunjungan ini merupakan bagian dari kegiatan kerja sama antara Fakultas Kehutanan UGM dan UNAMIN, sekaligus menjadi kesempatan untuk bertukar pengetahuan mengenai pengelolaan fasilitas dan pengembangan riset di perguruan tinggi.

Delegasi UNAMIN terdiri atas Wakil Rektor IV Bidang Perencanaan, Kerjasama, Sumberdaya dan Unit Usaha, Ir. Irman Amri, ST., MT., IPM. serta Dekan Fakultas Teknik, Dr. Ir. Hendrik Pristianto, S.T., M.T., IPM. Kegiatan turut dihadiri Dekan Fakultas Kehutanan UGM, Prof. Dr. Dwiko Budi Permadi, dan Dr. Ratih Madya Septiana. Dari Smart Agriculture Research Center, kunjungan diterima oleh Koordinator Peneliti, Dr. Andri Prima Nugroho, bersama tim.

Dalam pembukaan kegiatan, Dwiko menyampaikan bahwa UNAMIN telah memperoleh hibah pendanaan untuk laboratorium terpadu. Sehubungan dengan hal tersebut, kunjungan ini dimanfaatkan untuk mempelajari pengelolaan laboratorium, penelitian, serta fasilitas pendukung di lingkungan UGM, baik pada tingkat universitas, fakultas, maupun departemen.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1021-1-image-1.webp)

Diskusi juga membahas kelembagaan penelitian di UGM. Dwiko memperkenalkan keberadaan pusat studi pada tingkat universitas, pusat kajian di lingkungan fakultas, serta kelompok penelitian atau _research group_. Pembahasan tersebut memberikan gambaran mengenai berbagai bentuk organisasi riset yang dapat menjadi bahan pertimbangan dalam pengembangan laboratorium terpadu UNAMIN.

Pada kesempatan yang sama, Andri memperkenalkan Smart Agriculture Research Center di bawah Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem FTP UGM. Ia turut menjelaskan dukungan UGM AI serta NVIDIA terhadap riset yang dikembangkan sebagai salah satu _flagship research_. Sejumlah bidang penelitian diperkenalkan kepada rombongan, mencakup pertanian lahan terbuka atau _open field_, pertanian dalam ruang atau _indoor farming_, serta modernisasi irigasi.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1021-2-image-2-773x1030.webp)

Selain berdiskusi, rombongan meninjau fasilitas penelitian, meliputi laboratorium desain, mekanisasi pertanian, fasilitas pengujian alat dan mesin pertanian, serta Smart Agri Plant Factory. Peninjauan ini memberikan kesempatan bagi delegasi UNAMIN untuk melihat secara langsung fasilitas yang mendukung kegiatan penelitian dan pengembangan teknologi pertanian di FTP UGM.

Kunjungan ke Smart Agri Plant Factory berlangsung bertepatan dengan masa panen. Melalui peninjauan tersebut, rombongan dapat melihat kegiatan budidaya dalam ruang sebagai salah satu bagian dari penelitian pertanian cerdas yang dikembangkan oleh tim Smart Agriculture Research Center.

Dalam pembahasan tindak lanjut, Irman menyampaikan harapan agar komunikasi dapat dilanjutkan, termasuk apabila tim UGM memiliki agenda kegiatan di Manokwari atau Oransbari. Kesempatan tersebut diharapkan dapat dimanfaatkan untuk memperoleh masukan terkait pengembangan laboratorium pengujian di Sorong.

Kunjungan ini menjadi sarana pertukaran pengalaman dalam pengelolaan laboratorium dan pengembangan penelitian antarperguruan tinggi. Melalui komunikasi yang berkelanjutan, kerja sama UGM dan UNAMIN diharapkan dapat mendukung penguatan fasilitas riset serta kapasitas perguruan tinggi dalam menjawab kebutuhan pembangunan daerah.
